fields.Name: T021 - Lists Create and Populate
fields.Description: Verifies that a new list can be created in the Lists app for the People entity and that at least one People record can be added to it and shown in the list.
fields.ExpectedOutcomes:
{
  "goalCompleted": true,
  "minConfidence": 0.7,
  "maxSteps": 50,
  "judgeValidationCriteria": [
    "A list named 'Regression Test List 2' was created for the People entity",
    "At least one People record has been added to the list",
    "The list view displays the added People record (a populated row, not an empty list)",
    "No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages"
  ]
}
